gws.title: Google Workspace
gws.description: Once connected, the AI can work in your Google account for you: read and send Gmail, read and edit Sheets and Docs, upload to Drive, and add Calendar events. You connect once and every task on the team uses that one Google account, so a dedicated work account is best. It updates itself to Google's latest official version every day.

cli.title: WeCom / Feishu / DingTalk
cli.description: Once a platform is connected, the AI can work in it for you: send messages, read and edit docs and sheets, manage calendars and to-dos. Each platform is connected once, and every teammate's tasks share that connection, so sign in with a dedicated work account. The AI can only use the platforms connected here. Connected platforms update to the official latest version every day; there is nothing to update by hand.

dingtalk_cli_access: Open the 「CLI设置」 (CLI settings) link below and sign in by scanning with DingTalk. In the console it is under 「更多」 (More) → 「基本信息」 (Basic info) → 「CLI设置」 on the left.
Check that the switch at the top right of 「DWS CLI管理」 (DWS CLI management) says 「已开启」 (On).
Under 「Agent管理」 (Agent management), turn on the 「其他渠道」 (Other channels) row. Vibe Seller counts as 「其他渠道」, which DingTalk keeps off by default.
If that row's 「生效范围」 (Scope) is not 「全员可用」 (Everyone), click 「设置」 (Settings) and add the DingTalk account used to sign in.
DingTalk takes a few minutes to apply it. Then come back and click {{button}} to sign in again.

google_client.title: First, a one-time setup: create your Google sign-in key
google_client.intro: Google needs a sign-in key from your own Google Cloud project before anything can sign in to your account. It is free, takes about 5 minutes, and you only do it once. Open each link with the Google account you want to connect.
steps: Create a project (any name, for example “vibe-seller”). Then click the project name at the top left and make sure the new project is selected (Google sometimes stays on a project you used before).
Turn on the five Google services the AI uses (Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar): click Next, then Enable.

Open Google Auth Platform and click Get started: any app name; pick your email as the user support email; choose External as the audience; type your email as the contact and press Enter; tick the agreement, click Continue, then Create.
Under Audience, find Test users, click Add users, type the Google account you want to connect, press Enter and click Save. Make sure the account now shows in the test users list.

Under Clients, click Create client, choose Desktop app as the application type (any name) and click Create. In the window that opens, click Download JSON right away: once that window is closed, the file can no longer be downloaded.
Come back here and choose the file you just downloaded (its name starts with “client_secret”).

ads.title: Vibe Seller Ads API
ads.blurb: Once authorized, the AI changes your ads directly through the Amazon Ads API instead of clicking through a browser — faster and steadier for bulk changes. Amazon stores only for now.

ads.step2: Open it in Ziniao (or that store's browser), sign in to Amazon Seller Central and approve
ads.step3: Come back to this page and click Done authorizing

adspower.LoginRequired: The AdsPower client needs you to sign in: open AdsPower, sign in with the account the API key belongs to, finish the verification it asks for (an email/SMS code), then refresh or retry the task.
adspower.AccountMismatch: AdsPower doesn't accept this API key: copy the key of the account currently signed in to AdsPower (under API & MCP) and re-paste it into Vibe Seller; re-paste it after any account or key change.
adspower.ApiNotEnabled: AdsPower's API is unavailable: team members need their admin to grant API access in the team settings. Check that, then refresh.
adspower.StoreNotFound: AdsPower can't find this profile: it may have been deleted, or isn't authorised for the signed-in account. Check that, then retry.
adspower.UnsupportedKernel: This profile uses the FlowerBrowser (Firefox) kernel; Vibe Seller can only drive SunBrowser (Chrome kernel) profiles. Create a new profile with 浏览器 set to SunBrowser in AdsPower, then re-bind this store to it.
adspower.StoreUnavailable: This profile can't be opened right now. If it says the browser kernel is missing, open the AdsPower app and download that kernel in its settings, then retry.
adspower.LoadFailed: Could not load the profile list; refresh to retry.
adspower.NoAccount: AdsPower has no API key yet: open API & MCP in AdsPower, generate a key and paste it into Vibe Seller.
adspower.OneAccount: One AdsPower login per machine (the key must match it). To switch accounts, delete every AdsPower store first.
adspower.LoginAllRequired: Please fill in the API key.
adspower.ClientNotRunning: Could not find AdsPower: install and open it first; if it is installed elsewhere, pick its install location in Settings, then refresh.
